topic: Prowler public-source research for BugVault cloud-misconfiguration hunt planning
method: Initial retrievals used webfetch; subsequent bounded source batches used fetch in the confined execute runtime. No source installation, execution or target API calls. Blob citations in notes correspond to the same pinned raw file paths. No dependency or linked external documentation sites were followed.

path_source_url_rule: For each source with path P, fetched URL is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prowler-cloud/prowler/a5fd2d7eda90e9d59e0c4bfc0c74284b47529694/P and citation URL is https://github.com/prowler-cloud/prowler/blob/a5fd2d7eda90e9d59e0c4bfc0c74284b47529694/P. Per-file exact URLs are also linked inline throughout prowler.md.
epistemic_limits: Provider counts are periodically updated README claims, not independently executed enumeration.
Source review uses master commit, not a full review of distinct release commit.
Release-note claims about provider changes were not independently verified with provider websites.
Selected source review only; not a whole-repository safety, permissions, licensing-dependency or redaction audit.
Recommendations are independently written plans, not implemented BugVault or tested cloud procedures.
No real target facts, cloud accounts, credentials, API requests, payloads or exploitation evidence were produced.
